annotation.bound_parties_text: The directive sets standards and requirements for individuals and operators in Malaysia seeking approval for agricultural UAS operations, including AWC holders and remote pilots.
annotation.bound_parties_quote:
This CAD contains the standards, requirements and procedures to individuals and operators
in Malaysia seeking approval for agricultural operations utilising an Unmanned Aircraft System
annotation.dates_quote: and comes into operation on 15 November 2022.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Civil Aviation Directive 6011 (II) - Agricultural UAS Operations (CAD 6011 (II) – AGR), Issue 01/Revision 01, and comes into operation on 15 November 2022.
